newsitem.title: INDIA: India lower house to discuss finance bill Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: India lower house to discuss finance bill Tuesday.

text.p: India's lower house in parliament (Lok Sabha) will debate the finance bill for 1996/97 (April-March) on Tuesday, officials said.
Finance Minister P. Chidambaram will open the debate by introducing the bill on Tuesday, they said.
"We expect him to reply to the discussions on Wednesday if the debate drags on late into Tuesday," a parliament official told Reuters.
On Monday, the lower house approved a bill which appropriates money to all ministries and departments for 1996/97, parliamentary officials said.
The measure did not include tax measures, which are included in the finance bill.
Financial markets expect Chidambaram to announce changes in a proposed minimum alternate tax on high-growth companies in his speech.
The finance bill is expected to be voted and approved before the scheduled adjournment of parliament on Friday, September 13.
